name: template_in_later_file_import_alias_rt
description: bug-911 (A): an instantiation of a user template binds its import aliases in the file that DECLARES the template. `src/a.mfb` (the first source file) and `src/z.mfb` both bind the alias `lib`, to different packages; the template in z.mfb calls `lib::idI` and must reach the package z.mfb imports. A type argument still comes from the calling file: a PRIVATE record of a.mfb, and a record of the package only a.mfb imports, under the alias z.mfb binds elsewhere.
